mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Crippled</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Move Speed is reduced. They will gradually return to normal over the duration of this debuff.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Flurry</titleLeft><mainText>Lee Sin has increased Attack Speed and his attacks restore <scaleLevel>@spell.LeeSinPassive:TTFirstHitEnergy@</scaleLevel>/<scaleLevel>@spell.LeeSinPassive:EnergyReturn@</scaleLevel> energy.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Lee Sin's Abilities grant him <attackSpeed>@PassiveAS@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for two Attacks. The first Attack restores <keywordMajor>@TTFirstHitEnergy@ Energy</keywordMajor> and the second restores <keywordMajor>@EnergyReturn@ Energy</keywordMajor>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Tempest</titleLeft><mainText>Lee Sin is tracking this unit and can hit them with Cripple.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple.
Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals @InitialDamage@ magic damage and reveals them for @SlowDuration@ seconds. If this hits an enemy, Lee Sin can Recast for the next @ReactivateTime@ seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin Slows nearby enemies struck by the shockwave by @SlowAmount@% decaying over @SlowDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Sonic Wave</titleLeft><mainText>Lee Sin has <keyword>True Sight</keyword> of this unit and can attack them with Resonating Strike.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.
Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound, dealing @InitialDamage@ physical damage to the first enemy hit, granting True Sight of them, and allows Lee Sin to Recast for the next @ReactivateTime@ seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by the sound wave, dealing between @RecastDamage@ to @EmpoweredDamage@ physical damage scaling with the target's missing Health.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Dragon's Rage</titleLeft><mainText>This unit will damage and knock up any allied units it collides with.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick Knocking Back an enemy champion and dealing @Damage@ physical damage.

Enemies the target collides with are briefly Knocked Up and take @Damage@ plus @PercentHPCarryThrough@% of the kicked enemy's bonus Health as physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The target is <status>Rooted</status> during the cast time.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.
Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Lee Sin dashes to an ally or ward. If the target is a champion, Lee Sin grants them and himself @ShieldAmount@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and reduces this Ability's Cooldown by @W1CooldownRecovered*100@%. Lee Sin may Recast for the next @W1ReactivateTime@ seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin gains @LifestealAndSpellVamp@% Omnivamp for @LifestealAndSpellVampTime@ seconds.
